text:
sara: Quick PSA — release cut is at 5pm PT. Please keep changelog entries to one short sentence + a single component tag. We need to trim long blurbs today. If your PR currently has >1 line, please condense :pray:

 tim: got it, trimming mine now. which component tag should infra stuff use?

 sara: infra -> `infra`, runtime -> `runtime`, docs -> `docs`. Also include the PR like `(#1234)`. Example:

 ```
 runtime: reduced KV cache memory for small batches (#4321)
 ```

 alex: is there a lint check we can run locally?

 release-bot: changelog-lint v2 will run on PRs. To test locally: `python tools/changelog_lint.py path/to/entry.md`. Failing PRs get the `changelog:fix` label.

 tim: nice, thanks. denise — can you take release owner for this cut? :eyes: 

 denise: assigning myself as release shepherd. I'll do a pass at 4:30 and ping any long entries. Please add the `changelog-ready` label when you're done. :white_check_mark:

 alex: will prefill a one-liner and move long rationale into the PR body. Trying to avoid duplicate wording across entries.

 sara: perfect. tiny extra notes: follow keep-a-changelog tone (actionable, past-tense), no internal-only notes, and use component tags for searching. If you need help compressing, ping me and I can suggest a one-liner. :thumbsup:
